_note.en: Inverter data extracted as numbers from a manufacturer data sheet. The 'inverter' block has the keys the engine expects in arrays[].inverter. Not verified (status pending review).
_note.es: Datos de inversores extraidos como numeros de una ficha de fabricante. El bloque 'inverter' tiene las claves que el motor espera en arrays[].inverter. No verificado (status pending review).

inverters.source: SMA Sunny Tripower 15000TL/20000TL/25000TL data sheet (STP25000TL-30-DES1742-V31, October 2017)
inverters.note: isc_max_input_a is not printed on the data sheet: left null, to be confirmed with the manufacturer; the engine requires a number there. Efficiency vs load is only a graph in the sheet and is not extracted.
